files.description: Daily store traffic (90 rows): store (name such as "Store 07"), sales (whole number of sales, zero on some days), visits (whole number of visits, zero on some days; about 3% empty), open_sunday (True or False; about 8% empty).

task_text: Keep sales and visits as whole-number columns that allow empty cells (convert the table to the best-fitting column types after reading). The conversion rate of a store-day is sales divided by visits; days with empty or zero visits have no usable rate and are skipped. For each store, give the average conversion rate over its usable days. `result` should be a Series indexed by store.
intended_computation: Per store (30 stores, 3 days each), the mean of sales/visits over the days whose visits is non-empty and non-zero.

predicted_direction.reason: On 2.x the 0/0 days were NaN values inside the nullable column, so the store mean became NaN; on 3.x they are missing and skipped as the task asks.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N02; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
